newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in moderate trade.

text.p: Saudi Arabian stocks ended 0.61 percent higher in moderate trade last week, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index closed at 153.76 points on Thursday from 152.83 points. Of the 58 companies traded, 30 rose, 10 fell and 18 were unchanged.

Services sector shares dominated trade, accounting for 32 percent of volume. BFA said turnover in the week was 2.98 million shares worth 586 million riyals ($156.2 million) from 3.5 million shares worth 642 million riyals the previous week.

The biggest gainer was Yanbu Cement Company, which closed 7.9 percent higher at 192 riyals. Saudi Cement Company was the most actively traded share accounting for 7.5 percent of trading volume, BFA figures show. Saudi Cement ended 1.1 percent higher at 188 riyals.
Another active stock was Saudi Basic Industries Corp, which accounted for 7.2 percent of volume traded. The share price ended 1.5 percent higher at 407 riyals.
Food Products Co was also a major gainer adding five riyals to 109, and Saudi Arabian Public Transport Co ended three riyals higher at 105 riyals.
Al-Mawashi Al-Mukairish 50 percent was the leading decliner in the week closing at 36 riyals, 7.7 percent lower than a week earlier. SCECO-Eastern droppped 4.3 percent to 88 riyals.
Saudi Cairo Bank lost 2.2 percent to 266 riyals, and Saudi Hollandi Bank lost 1.8 percent to 436 riyals. ($1=3.75 riyals)
